brief: A habit tracker as a garden — daily completion waters plants, streaks bloom, neglect wilts

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor: plants growing/blooming as habit progress is intuitive, emotionally warm, and rewards consistency visibly.
Soft sky-to-soil gradient with sun creates a calming ambient scene that reinforces the garden world.
dominant_weaknesses: Severe layout collision: 'Garden Habits' header overlaps the stats panel, making both labels and numbers illegible.
Plant illustrations are crude geometric ovals on sticks; craft level undermines the otherwise poetic concept.
Streak badges (21, 14) float disconnected from plants, and habit pills feel generic against the illustrated scene.
fix_priorities: Resolve z-index/positioning so header, stats card, and CTAs occupy distinct space without text overlap.
Upgrade plant SVGs with varied silhouettes, leaves, and bloom states tied to streak length.
Anchor streak counters and labels to each plant pot with a unified typographic system.
Introduce subtle motion (sway, watering droplets, wilt) to make state changes felt rather than counted.
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective metaphor leads, visceral charm is moderate, but behavioral clarity collapses under the broken header overlap.
rationale.intent_fit: Concept executes the brief directionally — plants reflect streaks and neglect — but the broken composition and low illustration craft prevent the garden from feeling alive.
